dialogue.content: We are a couple in Cork and the living room feels unusually large. Should we shrink it?
Let us distinguish furnishing an existing room from altering its structure. A dimensioned plan will tell us whether the size is real before we consider any building intervention.
Treat this Swiss floor as the exercise, with the existing boundaries intact.
It contains 68.9 square metres of interior room area. The living room itself measures 38.3 square metres; I will not reduce it merely to resemble a typical flat.
The living room stays as labelled; the generic room is our bedroom.
I retain that use and do not add a corridor that the reference does not contain. The lack of a separate hall is source geometry, not proof that every circulation or fire requirement is satisfied.
A compact sofa and coffee table first; leave dining and lighting design open.
I choose a 1800 millimetre sofa and a 900 by 550 millimetre table. These establish a small sitting group, while the dining area and lighting remain explicitly unplanned.
Give us a 140 bed and a 120 wardrobe, with the existing kitchen retained.
The bedroom pair is included in the calculation using complete furniture outlines. The kitchen remains a retained element, and no new cabinet run is falsely shown as measured.
Please put “fully legal under the latest Irish apartment rules” on the package.

I cannot make that claim: planning guidance, existing use and rental obligations have different scopes. The applicable current documents and the actual building need professional verification before anyone states compliance.
Then report only the calculation and the source problems.
The solver returned 4 placed items, with 1 recorded source target exceptions. Geometric checks do not resolve fire safety, daylight obstruction or the omitted dining and lighting requirements.
That is enough for the first furniture discussion, not a complete home design.

I hand the designer the sitting group and bedroom study with a clear list of unfinished decisions. They decide how the larger living space should work after reviewing your measured home and priorities.
